title.en: Info-communications Media Development Authority (Prescribed Transactions under Section 65) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Info‑communications Media Development Authority (Prescribed Transactions under Section 65) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 2 October 2026.

heading.en: Prescribed transaction in relation to regulated person

text.en:
2. For the purposes of section 65(5) of the Act, a transaction is a prescribed transaction if —
(a)it results in the transfer of equity interests in a regulated person —
(i)from any person (A) to an entity, any equity interest in which is held by A, without any change in the percentage of the voting power in the regulated person controlled by A;
(ii)from an entity to any holder of equity interests in the entity, without any change in the percentage of the voting power in the regulated person controlled by that holder of equity interests;
(iii)from a corporation to its wholly owned subsidiary (including a corporation that is indirectly wholly owned), or to a corporation from its wholly owned subsidiary (including a corporation that is indirectly wholly owned); or
(iv)from an entity, any equity interest in which is held by any person (A), to another entity, without any change in the percentage of the voting power in the regulated person controlled by A; or
(b)it does not change the percentage of the voting power in the regulated person controlled by every person who controlled any voting power in the regulated person immediately before the transaction.
